sponsor_or_proposer: Chevron (via Noble Energy Cameroon / Noble Energy Equatorial Guinea) operator; Governments of Cameroon & Equatorial Guinea (unitization); New Age holds adjacent Etinde interest
current_state: Cross-border unitization & operating agreement signed 2026-02-06 (Malabo) to jointly develop the Yoyo (Cameroon) / Yolanda (Equatorial Guinea) fields, ~2.5 Tcf. Per the announcements the gas is to be LIQUEFIED at Equatorial Guinea's existing Punta Europa LNG complex (EG, not Cameroon), with a secondary axis piping gas to Bipaga in Cameroon for DOMESTIC/industrial supply. No new LNG liquefaction terminal or FLNG facility is described as sited in Cameroon.
missing_threshold_elements: No new LNG terminal/facility located IN CAMEROON (liquefaction is at Punta Europa, Equatorial Guinea; the Cameroon leg is a gas pipeline to Bipaga for domestic use, not an LNG terminal). Concrete step is field-development/unitization, not a Cameroon terminal build. Fails the 'new Cameroon terminal exists' test.
watch_for: Any decision to site a NEW liquefaction/FLNG facility in Cameroon for Yoyo gas (rather than tolling at Punta Europa in EG); FEED/FID on a Cameroon-located unit; or a material change to the in-GEM Etinde FLNG proposal arising from the Cameroon–EG treaty (the treaty also covers the Etinde field). Note: the liquefaction angle is primarily relevant to GEM's EQUATORIAL GUINEA / Punta Europa coverage, not Cameroon.
notes: Three INDEPENDENT non-GEM sources verified PASS (Yoyo) via url_verifier.py: World Oil (best_lead_url), Business in Cameroon (https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/0402-15712-cameroon-equatorial-guinea-agree-on-yoyo-yolanda-gas-unitization-deal), and Ecofin Agency (https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-industry/0502-52606-cameroon-e-guinea-sign-agreement-to-jointly-develop-4b-cross-border-gas-field).
